sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 610. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 180% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 100% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 120 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
Fire and Dark Defense from Unison Damage +600
